name: Semgrep MCP (Semgrep Guardian)
summary: Semgrep's MCP server, now shipped in the semgrep CLI (`semgrep mcp`) and bundled as Semgrep Guardian plugins to scan agent-written code for vulnerabilities.
description: The standalone `semgrep/mcp` repo is archived; the server moved into the main `semgrep` repository and is invoked with the `mcp` subcommand of the Semgrep CLI (`brew install semgrep`), over stdio or Streamable HTTP. Semgrep Guardian packages it for Claude Code (plugin marketplace, then `/setup-semgrep-plugin`), Cursor (Cursor Plugin Marketplace), VS Code/Copilot, Windsurf and Kiro. Some tools connect to the Semgrep AppSec Platform and need a login and Semgrep token.

agent_access.notes: Local scanning needs no key; Semgrep AppSec Platform tools need `semgrep login` / a Semgrep token. The archived semgrep-mcp PyPI package and ghcr.io/semgrep/mcp image are the old standalone distribution.
